headline: Pakistan Introduces New Auto Policy Focused on Affordable Vehicles and EVs
summary: Pakistan's federal government announced a new automotive policy centered on promoting cheaper vehicles and electric vehicles.
why: Automotive policy shifts impact capital investments, vehicle pricing structures, and adoption rates for green transportation technologies within the country.

impacts.name: Automotive Sector
impacts.why: New regulatory frameworks and incentives directly alter cost structures and production targets for vehicle manufacturers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
